claim.text: As of {{vintage.data_period_label}}, EU fuel reserves sit in a {{state.overall}} band overall
with jet fuel and petrol both rated {{eu.jet_fuel.status}} and diesel at {{eu.diesel.status}} against the {{reference.days}}-day OilWatch reference line
{{vintage.data_period_label}} reserve figures, {{vintage.lag_months}} months behind today
show jet fuel carrying the tightest cover of the three products
its unweighted EU mean of {{eu.jet_fuel.days}} days across {{count.jet_fuel.assessable}} assessable figures of {{count.jet_fuel.total}}
sits well below the {{reference.days}}-day OilWatch reference line
{{count.jet_fuel.below_reference}} of the {{count.jet_fuel.assessable}} assessable member states are below the OilWatch reference line.
One country's jet fuel figure is withheld as a reported zero, unresolved under current policy.
Petrol is also under strain: its unweighted mean of {{eu.petrol.days}} days across all {{count.petrol.assessable}} assessable figures places it below the OilWatch reference line
{{count.petrol.below_reference}} of {{count.petrol.assessable}} assessable member states are below the OilWatch reference line, with {{count.petrol.critical}} banded critical
Diesel offers the least-stressed picture among the three fuels, with an unweighted mean of {{eu.diesel.days}} days across {{count.diesel.assessable}} assessable figures.

{{count.diesel.below_reference}} of {{count.diesel.assessable}} assessable member states remain below the {{reference.days}}-day OilWatch reference line and {{count.diesel.critical}} are banded critical.
Across all fuels, {{count.any_fuel.critical}} of the {{count.countries.assessable}} assessable member states carry at least one critical-banded fuel.
On the {{brent.session_date_label}} session, Brent {{trend.brent_verb}} to {{brent.price_usd}} USD per barrel ({{brent.price_eur}} EUR)
the EU average pump prices as of the bulletin dated {{prices.bulletin_date_label}} stand at {{prices.eu.petrol}} EUR/litre for petrol and {{prices.eu.diesel}} EUR/litre for diesel
Jet fuel has the tightest unweighted EU mean at {{eu.jet_fuel.days}} days, the lowest of the three fuels assessed
Poland carries the thinnest jet fuel cover of all assessable member states at {{country.PL.jet_fuel.days}} days
Romania has the lowest cross-fuel average among assessable member states
Lithuania's jet fuel figure is withheld as a reported zero, unresolved under current policy, and carries no assessable cover value
Diesel remains the least-pressured product
with an unweighted EU mean of {{eu.diesel.days}} days, above the {{reference.days}}-day OilWatch reference line

stocks.basis: observation period (dataPeriod) — the first instant of the month the figures describe; NOT a publication date
stocks.note: stale once the observation month lags the present by more than 5 calendar months (lib/data-contract.ts FRESHNESS.stocks); Eurostat's release date is not in the payload and is not used

prices.basis: bulletinDate — the EC Weekly Oil Bulletin's reference date for the week (bulletinDateSource: excel-serial); NOT its publication date

brent.basis: observedAt on the provider's clock (sessionDate when the provider gives no instant); null when the quote is unavailable
brent.note: stale after 4 days (FRESHNESS.brent); quoteStatus current, provider Yahoo Finance (BZ=F)
